mcp:tool-listener.name: search_knowledge
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Search the internal knowledge corpus. Use before answering product, policy, pricing, support, or competitive questions.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import searchKnowledge from modules::Knowledge output application/json --- searchKnowledge( (payload.query default "") as String, (payload.limit default 5) as Number )

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_knowledge_document
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Load the full text of one internal knowledge article by id (for example product-catalog or discount-policy).

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import getDocument from modules::Knowledge output application/json --- getDocument((payload.id default "") as String)

mcp:tool-listener.name: list_knowledge_documents

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import listDocuments from modules::Knowledge output application/json --- listDocuments()
